title: Role brief
done when: You can pitch serverless vs dedicated vs fine-tune vs BYOC to a customer in two minutes, and say who you hand each problem to.

title: History of language models
done when: You can explain, in order, why n-grams gave way to RNNs and LSTMs, why seq2seq needed attention, and why the Transformer, scaling, RLHF, MoE, and reasoning models each followed.

title: Math of transformers
done when: You can derive backprop through softmax attention and compute, by hand, the FLOPs per token and the weight plus KV-cache memory of a 70B model.

title: Architecture variants
done when: Given any config.json you can name the variant: dense or MoE, MHA, GQA, or MLA, RoPE scaling, context length.

title: Frameworks: PyTorch, JAX, Keras 3
done when: The same tiny GPT trains in PyTorch and in JAX, and you can explain eager vs traced execution and where torch.compile and jit differ.

title: Loading models from the Hub
done when: You load a model from the Hub without the transformers library (safetensors header, config, tokenizer, chat template) and can diagnose the five most common load failures.

title: Training and post-training
done when: You run a LoRA fine-tune of an 8B model, evaluate it against the base on a held-out set, and can estimate GPU-hours and cost for a customer before starting.

title: Inference engine internals
done when: You can explain prefill vs decode, paged KV cache, continuous batching, quantization formats, and speculative decoding to both a researcher and a customer.

title: Serving and load
done when: You benchmark vLLM and SGLang on the same model, produce TTFT and TPOT vs concurrency curves, and pick a config that meets a stated SLO at the lowest cost per 1M tokens.

title: Full stack
done when: A streaming app with retrieval and an eval suite runs against your own endpoint, and you can show the eval delta when you swap the model.

title: Field craft
done when: From a mock customer brief you produce discovery notes and a POC plan with SLOs, eval criteria, a deployment hypothesis, and a cost estimate.
